q: He talks as if ______.
Fill in the Blank: If I _____ you, I would apologize.
Which of the following sentences is correct?
o: She laughed as though she has heard a funny joke.
She laughs as though she had heard a funny joke.
She laughed as though she had heard a funny joke.
She laughed as though she heard a funny joke.

q: He spoke as if he ______ the whole incident himself, though he had not.
e: As if বা as though-এর আগের অংশ past হলে এবং ঘটনাটি তারও আগে ঘটে থাকলে পরে Past Perfect বসে। সে কথা বলেছিল (Past Indefinite), আর ঘটনা দেখার ব্যাপারটি তার আগেই ঘটার ভান ছিল, তাই had witnessed হবে: He spoke as if he had witnessed the whole incident himself, though he had not. অর্থ: সে এমনভাবে বলছিল যেন সে নিজে পুরো ঘটনা দেখেছে, অথচ দেখেনি। Witnesses ও will witness কাল মেলায় না।

q: The office requires that we ___ our work timely.
e: Require, demand, insist, suggest, recommend এর পরে that-clause এলে Present Subjunctive ব্যবহার হয়, অর্থাৎ subject যাই হোক verb-এর base form বসে। তাই 'that we complete'। সঠিক বাক্য 'The office requires that we complete our work timely.'। অর্থ: অফিস চায় আমরা সময়মতো কাজ শেষ করি। 'have completed' ও 'completed' tense যোগ করে ফেলে, যা subjunctive-এর নিয়ম ভাঙে। 'should complete' অর্থের দিক থেকে সম্ভব হলেও বইয়ের মূল নিয়ম হলো শুধু base form।

q: If I __________ enough riches, I would have established a school for street children.
Which one is correct?
o: If I had a million dollars, I would traveled the world.
If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world.
If I had a million dollars, I had travel the world.
If I had a million dollars, I would have traveled the world.

q: If you cheat me, you ______ by yourself.
If I had been Shakespeare! (Make it Assertive)
o: I wish I had been Shakespeare.
I wished I had been Shakespeare.
I wish if I had been Shakespeare.

q: No sooner had he entered the room _____.
e: No sooner-এর সঙ্গে জোড়া বাঁধে than, অন্য কোনো শব্দ নয়। গঠন: No sooner + had + subject + past participle + than + পরের অংশ। তাই No sooner had he entered the room than the lights went out শুদ্ধ। অর্থ: ঘরে পা রাখামাত্রই আলো চলে গেল। and, when বা then বসালে গঠন ভেঙে যায়। আরেকটি উদাহরণ: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang।

q: Had we studied harder, we ________ better grades in the exam.
e: এটি third conditional। এতে Had দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া অংশ if-এর কাজ করে এবং সেই অংশ past perfect হয়। অন্য অংশে would have, could have বা might have-এর পরে verb-এর past participle বসে। Had we studied harder ধরনের গঠনের পরে মূল অংশ হবে we would have got better grades। এতে অতীতের একটি অবাস্তব শর্তের অনুমিত ফল বোঝায়। উদাহরণ: Had she left earlier, she would have caught the train।

q: He did not go there. He _____ if I had told him.
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: If he _______ the opportunity, he _______ the competition.

Find out the error. (26-30). Had I been a king, I would have help the poor.
